scene: the same art room on the first morning back, chairs down, blinds up, one board already half covered in brown paper and a staple gun sitting on the trolley, three tall stools where there should be four, a note in someone else's handwriting taped where the fourth was, the sun coming in low from the left across the floor

a hospital car park at eight in the morning from the top of the stairwell, cars in rows with the night's condensation still on the roofs, one space marked with a cone, a low mist over the grass bank behind and the sun just clearing the building, everything long-shadowed and blue-grey

a printed school timetable on a desk, a grid of periods with three cells highlighted yellow and one ringed hard in biro, the words year 9 fri 5 written in the margin with a line drawn under them twice, a mug ring on the corner of the paper, a stapler and a pot of pens out of focus behind, flat classroom daylight
